latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.23
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.23

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.23. Control and the Inkling engines (every backend) are 0.1.70, and so are the Windows and Mac Qwen engines. The Linux and aarch64 Qwen engines (0.1.69) and the Hy4 engine (0.1.67) have no changes, so nothing is downloaded for them.

## What's new

- **New Inkling 2 Mini files.** Five builds to choose from: **SQ-20** (19.37 GB), **SQ-15** (14.35 GB), **SQ-10** (10.47 GB), **GSQ-RCO IQ3_S** (11.43 GB) and **Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL** (17.63 GB). SQ-20 is a new "v2" file (16 KiB-aligned layout); SQ-15 and SQ-10 are the same files as in 0.2.22. The picture file (Vision v2) is 0.64 GB. If you have the old SQ-20, it shows "Update available": installing it downloads the new file and keeps the old one on disk until you remove it. Update the engine together with the model: the 0.2.22 engine refuses the new files with a clear error.
- **DFlash 2 drafter.** It replaces DSpark and needs one extra 0.55 GB file, downloaded and checked with the model. A drafter guesses the next words and the model checks them, so accepted words cost less time. It is on by default on Radeon RDNA 2 / 3 / 4, the R9700 and Strix Halo, on the Apple M5 Max with the SQ-20 v2 file, and on NVIDIA by card size: from 24 GiB for up to 32 requests at once, below 24 GiB for a single request and from 16 at once. It is not loaded when it would push part of the model off the card, and cards that keep part of the model in RAM run without it (the Tesla P100 is the exception). Opt-in on Intel Arc (`--draft on`: +25% to +32% on an Arc Pro B70). `--draft off` always turns it off.
- **Fast mode on by default** on the RTX 5090, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB, RTX 5070 12 GB, RTX PRO cards, DGX Spark and Radeon R9700. It can change the exact words of an answer slightly. `STRATA_INK_SM120=0` turns it off; `STRATA_INK_SM120_EXACT=1` keeps the old words and is still faster on the 5090.
- **GSQ-RCO IQ3_S** runs with its own GPU kernels and fits a single 12 GB card.
- **Your own model files.** Add a fine-tune, a merge or another maker's quantization from the app's local-files screens or with `strata launch --model-path` (`--custom-label` names it): `.gguf` for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, `.strata` for HY-4 Flash, both for Inkling-2-Mini. Strata uses the files where they are, shows them with a Custom badge, and never renames or deletes them; removing one only removes Strata's settings for it.
- **Windows crash on start with GGUF models fixed (#7131, #7155, #7206).** The five Windows Qwen engines are rebuilt as 0.1.70. **#7245:** an engine crash is now reported as an engine fault, not as a lack of RAM.
- **Strix Halo** reads prompts faster by default: 4K tokens 887 to 1,528 tok/s, 32K 675 to 1,270.
- **Olares One:** the Olares image `ghcr.io/niko1221/strata:0.2.23-cuda13` and two store apps (Inkling-2-Mini SQ-20 v2 and IQ3_S) are already out; the other Docker images follow.

## Speed

Decode in tok/s, one request, SQ-20 v2 unless noted. "Before" is the old path or no drafter; "now" is the 0.2.23 default. † = measured on a test build before the final merges.

| Card | Before | Now |
|---|---|---|
| RTX 5090 (final build) | chat 207.6, counting 415.2 | chat 360.5, counting 502.4 |
| RTX 5090, 64 requests at once (512 new tokens each) | 672.0 | 845.0 |
| RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB (final build) | code 80.4, counting 104.5 | code 260.7, counting 284.2 |
| RTX 5070 12 GB (release package) | – | 96.9 to 119.5 across prompt kinds |
| RTX 5060 8 GB (release package, part of the model in RAM) | – | 32.5 to 41.2 |
| RTX PRO 6000 †, reading a 4K prompt | 12,165 | 25,397 |
| DGX Spark (0.2.23 engine, 36 short prompts, 256 new tokens) | – | counting 125.2, chat 111.7, code 88.1; reading a 4K prompt 4,616 |
| DGX Spark, 32 requests at once (0.2.23 engine, 512 new tokens each) | – | 263.0 end to end, 513.6 steady |
| Radeon R9700 | 72.6 to 72.9 | counting 150.2, code 140.3, JSON 136.7 |

detail.readme:
Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Tencent Hy4-Flash | Pack | Your RAM | Graphics card | | --- | --- | --- | | **SQ-64** | 64 GiB | 8, 12 or 16 GiB | | **SQ-96** | 96 GiB | 8 or 12 GiB | | **SQ-128** | 128 GiB | 8 or 12 GiB | The number in the name is the RAM the pack is made for. [Hy4-Flash packs on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Hy4-Flash-Strata)
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
 Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B **Ornith AI (MIT):** Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, Q6_K, Q8_0. The same architecture and engine path as Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Catalog entry from eSPiYa's patch. [Sizes and setup](docs/MODELS.md#ornith-15-35b-a3b).
 Inkling 2 Mini | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **Strata** | SQ-20 (19.37 GB), SQ-15 (14.35 GB), SQ-10 (10.47 GB) | | **GSQ-RCO** | IQ3\_S (11.43 GB) | | **Unsloth** | UD-Q4\_K\_XL (17.63 GB) | SQ-20 is made for a 24 GiB graphics card, SQ-15 for 16 GiB and SQ-10 for 12 GiB. A 4 GiB card is enough to start. [Strata packs on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/strata-engine/Inkling-2-Mini-Strata) · [GSQ-RCO GGUF file](https://huggingface.co/ISTA-DASLab/Inkling-2-Mini-GSQ-RCO-GGUF) · [Unsloth GGUF files](https://huggingface.co/unsloth/Inkling-2-Mini-GGUF)
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.23-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.23-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.23-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Sponsors of Strata
